operatorDirective: Fix the factory, re-pilot, then fan.

scopeAmendment.reason: The accepted CP2 FAIL_STOP proved the merged production instrument unsafe. The operator explicitly authorized mechanism repair before resuming the original sweep.
repairs: Server-side projection to EPSG:4326; no coordinate-magnitude inference or hand conversion.
Service-declared objectIdField carried from metadata through staging.
Distribution and city-polygon coverage gates before LAYER-FOUND.
Permanent verification controls expanded with Elgin and Georgetown.

cityPolygonCoverage.numerator: summed area of server-returned EPSG:4326 candidate polygons clipped to the coverage denominator
cityPolygonCoverage.denominator: Census TIGERweb place polygon clipped to the layer's server-returned EPSG:4326 extent (city ∩ layer extent). County-split layers are graded against the city slice they declare, not the whole multi-county place.
cityPolygonCoverage.serverQuery: candidate features intersecting the city envelope with inSR=4326 and outSR=4326
cityPolygonCoverage.failurePosture: missing city polygon, failed reprojection, failed geometry query, or coverage below threshold rejects the candidate

extentScale.rule: server-returned EPSG:4326 layer extent area / city bbox area must be <= 8

thresholdAmendments.reason: Pre-pilot dry calibration measured permanent known-truth Bartonville at 0.41744780293432737 raw polygon coverage; 0.65 would invalidate the required control before the stage-apply re-pilot. Distribution thresholds remain frozen.

After Parks rejection, Denton City Limits (FeatureServer/27) still passed with CityCode abbreviations FRIS/DENT/PLAN and county-scale extent. Added extent-scale gate and tightened digit-free code grammar before stage-apply.

thresholdAmendments.to: featureCount>=4000 and city-envelope intersect count>=2000 accepts the 0.40 floor without exhaustive area paging
thresholdAmendments.reason: Austin Publish_Zoning_AGOL passed code gates after SF/MF hyphen fix but area-sampled coverage stalled at 0.095 with maxFeatures=2500 against a tens-of-thousands parcel inventory.
